assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
CPT 93229 is the code for mobile cardiac telemetry.
The diagnosis includes nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
The claim was denied for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The denial is based on reason code CO-22.
The denial indicates that care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits protocols.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
